main.description: A single completed attempt at an Isolith course. Written to the player's own repo when optional stat sync is enabled; the game never requires it.

courseId.description: Identifier of the course, e.g. 'ascent'. The literal 'endless' marks a procedurally generated run, in which case courseHash is the generator seed.

courseHash.description: For an authored course, the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the course JSON: times are only comparable within a single hash, so editing a course leaves old runs attached to the layout they were set on. For an endless run, the 16-character hex generator seed, which reproduces the run exactly.

completed.description: Whether the goal was reached. False records are permitted so partial attempts can be tracked.

deaths.description: Times the player was returned to a checkpoint.

sections.description: Sections cleared in an endless run. Absent or zero for an authored course.

total.description: Shards present in the course at the time of the run.
